inventory.source_identity: Compare source file fingerprints; generated envelope hashes and current Git HEAD can vary without source changes.

method: Explicit taxonomy from pinned source function/registration symbols and source object-name uses. Structural and layer exceptions received targeted code reading. Multi-purpose primitives and external assets retain explicit classification gaps.

semantics.primary_family: Dominant source semantics or named use only,not a guarantee that every object sharing routine has that art family.
semantics.secondary_family: Additional known source roles and layer/height context,not a runtime coverage proof.
semantics.unclassified: Multi-purpose primitives or external assets need per-object payload/context classification; no family guessed.
semantics.no_draw: Base function only; ObjectDrawer object-specific overrides can still draw or erase.
semantics.source_semantics: Function or explicit mapped-name semantics support taxonomy only. No claim of executing every routine or classifying each generic payload.
semantics.dispatch_exception_keys: Union of exception keys from both default and custom-enabled object joins; not solely default route.
semantics.object_joins: Derive default/custom-enabled object joins from generated inventory; the checker accounts for every object without copying object metadata into this file.
